source_title: Marisa Tomei Reveals Liam Neeson’s Favorite Restaurant During Filming (Exclusive) - People.com
source_excerpt:
The two costar in ‘The Mongoose,’ which was filmed in Australia
Tristan Fewings/Getty; Karwai Tang/WireImage
Marisa Tomei and Liam Neeson star opposite one another in The Mongoose , which was filmed in Australia
Tomei tells PEOPLE exclusively that the actor enjoyed eating at Nobu during filming
For the actress, getting to work with Neeson was one of the things that drew her to the film
Marisa Tomei learned some interesting facts about Liam Neeson while filming The Mongoose together in Australia.
While she took in everything it had to offer during her downtime, including the food, she told PEOPLE that Neeson, 74, preferred to stick with what he knew.
“Liam liked to go to Nobu a lot,” Tomei, 61, says while discussing some of the places she visited. “So he ate at Nobu quite a few times. I like to venture farther afield.”
After PEOPLE reminds Tomei that you can find Nobu in New York, she says, “He likes what he likes.”
Getting to work with Neeson drew her to the Mark Vanselow -directed film.
“The whole kit and caboodle was really about Liam and the fun of working with him,” she says. “Obviously, he’s a legend, but once you get to meet him and speak with him, he’s so funny. A lot of that humor does come through. The script is really well crafted to be an action movie as well as have that comedy in it, to have zingers.”
Tomei says she’s been a fan of Neeson since his 1993 revival of Anna Christie .
“I’ve admired him for a long time, and it seemed like it would be a film that was going to have a lot of action and fun packed in with a story that’s hard to tell in a lot of other genres,” she says of the Oscar-nominated actor.
“I think this was a really great way to tell this story of the trauma of war and what our American heroes go through, and then have it be extremely entertaining at the same time, and have this incredible actor at the center of it,” adds Tomei.
The Mongoose finds Neeson playing Ryan “Fang” Flanagan, a decorated combat veteran accused of murder. Tomei plays his concerned ex-wife Tara.
“With nothing to lose, Fang “leads law enforcement on a cross-country car chase with the help of his brothers in arms and a sympathetic public rooting for his getaway,” according to a synopsis.
